problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package Alpha: size 66 units
* Package Beta: size 51 units
* Package Gamma: size 45 units
* Package Delta: size 67 units
* Package Epsilon: size 64 units
* Package Zeta: size 52 units
* Package Eta: size 40 units
* Package Theta: size 39 units
* Package Iota: size 51 units
* Package Kappa: size 30 units
* Package Lambda: size 67 units
* Package Mu: size 33 units
* Package Nu: size 66 units
* Package Xi: size 39 units
* Package Omicron: size 52 units
* Package Pi: size 53 units
* Package Rho: size 48 units
* Package Sigma: size 70 units
* Package Tau: size 48 units

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 units. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total size of packages on any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
